name: zetesis
description: Zetesis: scientific claims grounded in dated, retrieved evidence.

plugins.name: zetesis
plugins.description: Ground scientific claims in real, dated, citable evidence. Retrieves primary literature, trial records and filings by hard id (PMID, DOI, NCT, grant, filing), supplies the grading rubric, and can evaluate a claim as it stood in an earlier year so it is judged on what was knowable at the time.
